original: 【MLB】大絶叫！　大谷翔平〝完全復活弾〟ついに出た58日116打席ぶり一発　64日ぶりの本拠地熱狂　「信じてくれる人のために…」　鬼気迫る猛練習実る
english: On Sanspo: [MLB] A roar of excitement! Shohei Ohtani's "full-comeback homer" finally arrives, his first home run in 58 days and 116 plate appearances; frenzy at the home ballpark for the first time in 64 days; "For the people who believe in me..."; his fierce, intense practice pays off.

original: 【速報します】崖っぷちドジャースは初勝利なるか　大谷翔平は今PS初の「1番」、グラスノー先発
english: At Sanspo: [Breaking News] Will the on-the-brink Los Angeles Dodgers get their first win? Shohei Ohtani bats leadoff for the first time this postseason, with Glasnow starting.

original: 大谷翔平、復活3ランに“両手バンザイ” 26試合ぶり一発…通算12本目で日本人記録更新
english: Full-Count: Shohei Ohtani's comeback 3-run homer, with both arms raised in celebration. His first home run in 26 games, his 12th career homer, setting a new record for a Japanese player.

original: ロバーツ監督、1番・大谷翔平と心中「トップに置くべきだ」 決断の背景に深夜の“居残り練習”
english: At Full-Count: Manager Roberts to go all-in with leadoff hitter Shohei Ohtani — "He should be placed at the top"; behind the decision, a late-night "extra practice session."

original: 中村敬斗が2アシスト、鎌田大地は公式戦2戦連発！ ELの“日本人対決”はリヨンに軍配、EL開幕2連勝
english: On Soccer King, Keito Nakamura had 2 assists and Daichi Kamada scored in his 2nd consecutive official match! The EL "Japanese showdown" went to Lyon, who won their first 2 EL matches.
